label: Reset dips after unrewarded trials (most after a1) and when S1 looks good, growing late in episode.
terms: (prev_reward == 0) * ep_dec ;; (prev_reward == 0) * (tv("reward", -2) == 0) * ep_dec ;; (prev_action == 1) * ep_dec ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_reward == 0) * ep_dec ;; belief_lo * ep_dec ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 1) * ep_dec ;; (prev_action == 1) * (prev_reward == 0) * ep_dec ;; (phase == D2) * (state == 1)
explanation: Raw reset gate r of unit 5 sits near 0.97-0.98 and sags late in the episode (timing baseline). Beyond timing it is pushed down after an unrewarded previous trial, most strongly after an unrewarded a1 choice (a1 S1 u at GO is about -0.047), and by S1-favouring evidence: ideal-observer belief that S1 is good, plus reaching S1 at D2. Rewarded a2 trials and S2-favouring belief raise it slightly. All of these effects grow with episode trial (ep_dec interaction), matching the bigger timing dip late. The free fit adds a loss-streak term (the trial before also unrewarded), an extra GO-specific loss drop and a D2 choice term, reaching dev 0.47 vs 0.40 for the short form. The deepest misses are long runs of losses late in the episode, where the gate drops to about 0.57 and the linear terms under-predict. Future reward adds nothing.
